title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(福江高志研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III(Fukue Takashi)
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) Acquire the ability to identify and solve problems to research, develop, design, and manufacture socially useful and high-quality products using the basic knowledge learned in the Department of Mechanical Engineering. (2) Learn what technologies or new mechanisms are needed for that purpose. (3) Learn about the importance of collaboration with society (particularly local communities).
advice: This is the final comprehensive course in the Department of Mechanical Engineering. To realize the educational objectives of the Department of Mechanical Engineering, this course focuses on the following goals: Students will acquire the ability to model phenomena accurately and analyze the models. Students will acquire the ability and the engineering sense to evaluate solutions using the obtained results. In practice, students should reconfirm their project theme, which was determined in Preparatory Seminar, with the supervisors of the individual laboratories. Students are expected to pursue the identification and solution of problems according to the engineering process. This laboratory conducts research on thermal-fluids engineering. Especially, basic researches on novel control technologies for transport phenomena from the viewpoint of biomimetics are conducted. Furthermore, design methods for attractive next-generation products based on concepts of 1DCAE and Delight Design are developed. This engineering research is advanced by considering the importance of co-creation and various values of regional collaboration.
books: Textbooks: N/A Reference books: N/A Reserved books: N/A
requiredKnowledge: It is desirable to have knowledge about the entire field of mechanical engineering. Especially, it is desirable to have a strong interest in transport phenomena (fluid mechanics, thermodynamics, and heat transfer). In addition, to employ various values and senses, it is desirable to have an attitude of interest in various daily discoveries. For safe management of the laboratory, students must understand the laboratory manual that was used in Preparatory Seminar.

activityGoals.body: Be able to advance your project in accordance with the engineering design process.
Be able to compile the results correctly into an article and discuss the content through presentations.
Be able to act independently to solve the issues presented separately.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Understand the project and the promotion process accurately, and achieve the established annual goal. In addition, the process can be reported in the Design Project Activity Support System. (2) Compile the intermediate results for the project into the interim report, and present and discuss its content. Complete the final report, present it to the Design Project III Public Presentation Review Board, and discuss its content. (3) If necessary, design and manufacture your own experimental devices, and also evaluate the performance of the product.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Understand the purpose of your project theme and the promotion process, and achieve the established annual goal. In addition, the process can be reported in the Design Project Activity Support System. (2) Compile intermediate results for the project into the interim report, and present its content. Complete the final report and present it to the Design Project III Public Presentation Review Board. (3) Design and manufacture your own experimental devices if necessary.
